World Map Marker Filter
Version 1.0.0

A searchable list of the world map's markers down the left of the map, each with its own icon. Hide or show a whole marker type
from a legend, or a single marker from its own menu. Choosing one centres the map on it.

USING IT
Open the world map and press D-pad left on a controller, or / on the keyboard. Outside the world map both presses are left to
the game.

Controller: D-pad up and down or the left stick moves. A centres the map on the highlighted marker and closes the panel. X opens
the on-screen keyboard. Y opens the highlighted marker's menu. RB shows the marker types. B closes the keyboard or menu, then the
panel.

The marker's menu: centre the map on it, hide it (or show it again), show only this one, show only this kind, and, while one of
those is on, show all. A hidden marker leaves the map and stays in the list, dimmed, and stays hidden in every game until shown
again. Markers of one name and icon go together. A "show only" lasts until Show all or the game closes.

Marker types: each type with how many markers it has. A hides or shows them all, and hidden types stay hidden in every game until
shown again. The type names come from the map's icon names, in English.

On-screen keyboard: QWERTY, then any other character the listed names use, then Space and Delete. The D-pad walks the keys, A
presses one, Y deletes.

Keyboard and mouse: type to search. Arrows or the wheel move. The right arrow opens the marker's menu, the left arrow shows the
types. Enter or a click centres the map. Backspace deletes. Esc or Tab closes.

WHAT IT LISTS
What the map shows. A marker you have not found is not on the map, so it is not here, and a marker type another mod has hidden is
left out. A marker the map shows as undiscovered is listed with that same icon.
The icons are drawn by your own map, so icon replacers and CoMAP's icons appear as they do on the map.
The panel wears the Apocrypha Menu Framework's theme, or the same style file as World Map Selector for Controller's panel when one
is installed.

REQUIREMENTS
SKSE64, Address Library for SKSE Plugins, the Apocrypha Menu Framework, and SkyUI's map (or a UI mod built on it, such as Norden UI).
Recommended with it: World Map Selector for Controller.

SETTINGS
SKSE\Plugins\WorldMapMarkerFilter.ini: the keys that open the panel, its width and text size. Read when the game starts.
Log: Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\WorldMapMarkerFilter.log
